blurb: Eagle Mountain Marinas offers boat rentals including tritoons, deck boats, wave runners, ski boats, kayaks, and paddle boards. Guests can enjoy boating, fishing, and water sports such as wake boarding, water skiing, and kayaking on Eagle Mountain Lake. The marina provides secure boat slips and a boat club for members.

quotes.author: Kelly Case
quotes.text: We had the best day with our dad out on the boat! I was so impressed with the amazing staff! I not only will be recommending this experience to my friends and family but am looking into joining the Boat Club! What a great idea! Thank you for everything and we will definitely see you again!

quotes.author: David Mayfield
quotes.text: I can't express how happy I am with the service I've gotten since coming in for the first time in January 2019. Being the owner of a very demanding business, I cant vacation like most. So, I bought a boat! I wanted to be in a nice marina and fell head over heels with this place!

quotes.author: Travis Schulte
quotes.text: It is wonderful to feel that my boat and other belongings are safe and watched over when I am not there. We have the nicest lake friends all around us and the marina staff is not only professional but we consider them family. Would not want my boat anywhere else.

quotes.author: Scott Diaz
quotes.text: Went here for the first time this past weekend and my girlfriend and I had a blast on the Yamaha Waverunner. We will defiantly be going back. Next time we're going to rent a boat.

quotes.author: Shawn Moore
quotes.text: Was very impressed didn't even know the lake was there my buddy just got a house on the lake. Always go to Lake Travis. Highly recommend beautiful lake!

quotes.author: Jon Wisdom
quotes.text: My boat has been docked here since 2005 and we have gone through a drought and severe weather events, but the service has always been great.
